### plan-unified-strategy-edge-20260705.md
- task_class: implementation
- tools_used:
  Bash×105 (grep/gates/git/codex-run.sh/SSM/cast), Read×33, Edit×17, Write×7 (Codex briefs, runbook,
                    memory), TaskCreate×8 + TaskUpdate×11 (per-slice tracking), ToolSearch×1, mark_chapter×1.
- evidence_order:
  locate plan + git log/status → read plan + related docs (HERMES.md, coffee-ev-protocol-credit-plan) →
                    grep code vs plan (strategy-taxonomy protocol/protocolAction, token-graph slotKind callers) → run
                    baseline gates BEFORE editing → A0 by hand + gate + commit → 4 Codex passes (a1/a2/b2/a5: brief file →
                    codex-run.sh → monitor thread.started/out → full git-diff review → gate → commit) → A6 main.ts edits +
                    gates → plan-doc/runbook/memory updates → SSM node-ops: read state → ancestor check → live-log check →
                    cast-verify → deploy-node.sh → background poll.
- analysis_frame:
  generator/evaluator split: Claude plans, authors only mechanical/config edits (A0, A6), evaluates every
                    Codex diff by the -o output file + git diff (never stdout); one slice = one brief = one gate = one
                    commit; node deploy treated as a separate phase with read-only verification before any restart.
- sanity_checks:
  baseline gates pre-edit (searcher:taxonomy, test:learning-case); per-slice: tsc --noEmit (listener +
                    analysis), searcher:planner (psm-reverse fixture), searcher:psm-quote, searcher:psm-build,
                    searcher:wsteth-quote, searcher:ac3, searcher:replay-live-fixtures; full-diff review of each Codex
                    surface; node: 09a9db8 ancestor-of-origin/main check, live-log-growth check (don't interrupt a window),
                    cast-verify (PSM tin=tout=0 ⇒ A1 live no-op; wstETH/stETH symbols+rates; sUSDS/wstUSR asset());
                    post-deploy banner verify scheduled (protocolEdges=disabled, bounded-live mode preserved).
- tool_gap:
  none (minor harness note: foreground `sleep` blocked during the deploy wait → worked around with a
                    background until-loop poll; not an analysis-tool shortfall).
- codify_next: no
- distill_for_opus:
  **Before restarting/deploying to the bounded-live node, run the read-only pre-deploy triple: (1) node
                    commit is an ancestor of origin/main (reset drops nothing), (2) live log is checked for an active
                    measurement window, (3) new protocol addresses/params are cast-verified against the node's reth — this
                    both chain-verifies the slice's assumptions and can prove a change is a live no-op (PSM tin=tout=0)
                    before it ships.**
